basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old mechanical engineer from Denver, Colorado, with a passion for tabletop gaming and 3D printing. I got into BattleTech about a year ago, and it quickly became a favorite. I enjoy building and painting miniatures as a way to unwind after work. In my spare time, I also love hiking in the Rockies and volunteering with local community projects. I'm single and usually online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in mechanical engineering and work in a design firm, which gives me a solid understanding of materials and structures. My interest in tabletop games started during college, where I learned about different game mechanics and design. I also taught myself 3D modeling and printing, which I now use to create custom terrain and miniatures.
